mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_report (target_type, target_id, reason_cd, reason, status, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}::integer, NULLIF(#{reasonCd}, ''), #{reason}, 'PENDING', 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason_cd, r.reason, r.status, (SELECT c.code_nm FROM t_code c WHERE c.code_id = r.reason_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'REPORT00') AS reason_nm, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'BBS' THEN (SELECT title FROM t_bbs WHERE bbs_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'RECRUIT' THEN (SELECT title FROM t_recruit WHERE recruit_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT LEFT(context, 40) FROM t_comment WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) END AS target_title, -- 대상으로 이동할 링크(관리자가 신고 내용을 직접 확인). 대상 삭제 시 NULL/미존재. CASE r.target_type WHEN 'BBS' THEN (SELECT '/gen/board/' || b.bbsinfo_id || '?post=' || b.bbs_id FROM t_bbs b WHERE b.bbs_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'RECRUIT' THEN '/gen/recruit/' || r.target_id WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT '/gen/board/' || b.bbsinfo_id || '?post=' || b.bbs_id FROM t_comment c JOIN t_bbs b ON b.bbs_id = c.bbs_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id) END AS link_url FROM t_report r WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.status = #{status} ORDER BY r.report_id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE t_report SET status = #{status}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE report_id = #{dbKey}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT report_id::TEXT AS db_key, target_type, target_id, status FROM t_report WHERE report_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_bbs SET use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE bbs_id = #{targetId}::integer
UPDATE t_comment SET use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{targetId}::integer
